## Spotify playlists in Streyn
- **Spotify playlists on the search page:** below "Browse all" there is a new row of categories, like on Spotify: Charts, Pop, Hip-Hop, German rap, Rock, Chill, Mood, Party, Workout, Focus, Sleep, Decades and many more. With Spotify connected it is Spotify's own list of categories with their pictures
- **Every playlist of a category:** a category opens all its playlists, Spotify's own (editorial) ones first, then the most popular ones of everyone else. Names, covers, descriptions and songs come from Spotify like in the Msik bot, the sound from YouTube
- **Open, play, save:** a playlist opens like any other: play, shuffle, preload, offline, and **Save to library** (then you can also rename it and give it your own cover)
- **Search:** playlists from Spotify still show up in the search results, and every Spotify playlist link can be opened or imported
- Without Spotify connected the categories show playlists from the catalog, with a hint how to connect Spotify

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android / Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
